properties.description: ceil32 MUST return the smallest multiple of 32 that is >= input value
properties.formal_specification: FORALL n: ceil32(n) % 32 = 0 AND ceil32(n) >= n AND ceil32(n) - n < 32
properties.rationale: Memory gas calculations depend on correct 32-byte alignment for word-based accounting.

properties.description: Values already aligned to 32 bytes MUST be returned unchanged
properties.rationale: Unnecessary rounding would cause over-charging for memory expansion gas.

properties.description: ceil32 input MUST be a non-negative unsigned integer
properties.formal_specification: FORALL n: ceil32(n) => n >= 0 AND n IN Uint
properties.rationale: Negative inputs or non-integer types would produce undefined behavior in gas calculations.

properties.description: Taylor exponential denominator MUST be non-zero to prevent division by zero
properties.rationale: Division by zero would cause runtime crash in fee market calculations.

properties.description: Taylor series MUST converge for all valid fee market inputs
properties.rationale: Non-convergence would cause infinite loop, blocking block production.

properties.description: Taylor exponential MUST approximate factor * e^(numerator/denominator) within acceptable precision
properties.formal_specification: ABS(taylor_exponential(f, n, d) - f * e^(n/d)) < ACCEPTABLE_ERROR
properties.rationale: Fee market calculations require accurate exponential approximation for correct base fee adjustment.

properties.description: Each Taylor iteration MUST reduce numerator_accumulated by dividing by increasing factorial terms
properties.rationale: Factorial denominator growth guarantees series convergence and prevents infinite loops.

properties.description: Byte-to-U32 conversion MUST use little-endian byte ordering consistently
properties.rationale: Endianness mismatch would corrupt cryptographic operations like BLAKE2.

properties.description: Byte-to-U32-to-Byte round-trip MUST produce identical bytes
properties.rationale: Non-reversible conversion would corrupt cryptographic state during serialization.

properties.description: Input bytes length MUST be a multiple of 4 for U32 conversion
properties.rationale: Non-aligned input would cause incomplete U32 values or out-of-bounds reads.

properties.description: U32 sequence to bytes conversion MUST produce exactly 4 bytes per U32 value
properties.rationale: Fixed-length output ensures consistent serialization across implementations.

properties.description: is_prime MUST return True only for integers > 1 with no divisors other than 1 and itself
properties.formal_specification: is_prime(n) = True IFF n > 1 AND (FORALL d: 2 <= d <= sqrt(n) => n % d != 0)
properties.rationale: Incorrect primality affects Ethash DAG parameters, though impact is limited.

properties.description: get_sign MUST return exactly -1, 0, or 1 based on value comparison to zero
properties.formal_specification: get_sign(x) = -1 IFF x < 0; get_sign(x) = 0 IFF x = 0; get_sign(x) = 1 IFF x > 0
properties.rationale: Consistent sign representation is critical for signed arithmetic operations.

properties.description: Integer division MUST use floor division semantics consistently
properties.formal_specification: FORALL a, b (b != 0): a // b = floor(a / b)
properties.rationale: Different rounding modes cause gas calculation discrepancies and consensus failures.

properties.description: Genesis block creation MUST only occur when no blockchain exists
properties.rationale: Genesis recreation on existing chain would corrupt state and cause consensus failure.

properties.description: Genesis block header MUST have zero parent hash (no parent exists)
properties.rationale: Non-zero parent hash would make genesis appear non-genesis, breaking chain validation.

properties.description: Genesis state root MUST be computed from all initial account allocations
properties.rationale: Incorrect state root causes immediate validation failure when syncing with network.

properties.description: Genesis configuration file MUST be trusted and integrity-verified
properties.rationale: Malicious genesis could pre-allocate funds to attackers or set exploitable parameters.

properties.description: Genesis block MUST be appended as block 0 (first block)
properties.rationale: Block 0 is universally expected for genesis; different numbering breaks client compatibility.

properties.description: Hex strings with 0x prefix MUST be parsed as hexadecimal
properties.rationale: Consistent hex parsing prevents value misinterpretation in allocations.

properties.description: Strings without 0x prefix MUST be parsed as decimal
properties.rationale: Decimal parsing for non-prefixed values matches standard JSON number handling.

properties.description: Account addresses MUST be exactly 20 bytes (40 hex chars + 0x prefix)
properties.rationale: Invalid address length would cause account storage corruption or lookup failures.

properties.description: Invalid genesis configuration MUST halt initialization with exception
properties.rationale: Continuing with invalid config could produce malformed chain state.

properties.description: Post-London genesis MUST include base_fee_per_gas field
properties.rationale: Missing base fee field causes header validation failure on London+ networks.

properties.description: Post-Shanghai genesis MUST include withdrawals_root field (empty root)
properties.rationale: Missing withdrawals field breaks Shanghai+ header validation.

properties.description: Post-Cancun genesis MUST include blob gas fields (excess_blob_gas and blob_gas_used)
properties.rationale: Missing blob fields breaks Cancun+ header validation and blob fee calculations.

properties.description: Pre-London genesis MUST NOT include base_fee_per_gas field
properties.rationale: Extraneous fields cause header deserialization mismatches on pre-London networks.

properties.description: DApp MUST establish event listener before dispatching eip6963:requestProvider
properties.rationale: Dispatching request before listening may miss immediate wallet announcements.

properties.description: DApp event listeners MUST persist for entire page lifetime
properties.rationale: Wallets may announce after DApp initialization; short-lived listeners miss late announcements.

properties.description: Each received EIP6963ProviderDetail MUST be persisted for user selection
properties.rationale: Discarding provider info prevents users from selecting those wallets.

properties.description: Wallet extension code is untrusted and executes in page context
properties.rationale: Extensions can modify page objects; DApps must apply defensive measures.

properties.description: Each provider announcement uuid MUST be unique per session
properties.formal_specification: FORALL p1, p2: p1 != p2 AND SameSession(p1, p2) => p1.uuid != p2.uuid
properties.rationale: Duplicate UUIDs indicate impersonation attempt or malicious extension.

properties.description: Provider info uuid MUST be valid UUIDv4 format
properties.rationale: Invalid UUIDs break uniqueness detection and may indicate malformed provider.

properties.description: Provider info rdns MUST be valid RFC-1034 domain in reverse notation
properties.rationale: Invalid RDNS may indicate spoofing or malformed extension.

properties.description: Provider info icon MUST be RFC-2397 data URI with at least 96x96 resolution
properties.rationale: Proper icon size ensures visual distinction between wallets to prevent impersonation.

properties.description: Provider detail object MUST be frozen with Object.freeze() before dispatch
properties.rationale: Freezing prevents prototype pollution attacks from malicious extensions.

properties.description: SVG icons MUST be rendered via tag only, never inline, to prevent script execution
properties.rationale: Inline SVG can execute embedded JavaScript, enabling XSS attacks from malicious wallets.

properties.description: Prototype pollution attempts MUST be blocked by frozen objects
properties.rationale: Frozen objects prevent attackers from modifying prototypes to hijack provider calls.

properties.description: DApps MUST NOT assume EIP-1193 provider from announcement is authentic without user verification
properties.rationale: Malicious extension could substitute fake provider that steals keys or redirects transactions.

properties.description: All nodes MUST use identical genesis configuration for same chain_id
properties.formal_specification: FORALL node1, node2: node1.chain_id = node2.chain_id => node1.genesis = node2.genesis
properties.rationale: Different genesis configs produce different state roots, causing consensus failure.

properties.description: Assets directory MUST exist and be readable for genesis loading
properties.rationale: Missing assets directory causes initialization failure preventing node startup.

properties.description: Mainnet genesis nonce SHOULD be 0x42 (Douglas Adams reference)
properties.rationale: Conventional nonce for mainnet compatibility; other networks may differ.

properties.description: Wallets MUST announce on both page load AND requestProvider event to handle race conditions
properties.formal_specification: FORALL wallet: (AnnounceOnPageLoad(wallet) OR AnnounceOnRequest(wallet)) ENSURES DiscoverySucceeds(wallet)
properties.rationale: Race between DApp and wallet loading requires dual announcement strategy.

properties.description: Duplicate UUID detection MUST flag provider as suspicious for potential impersonation
properties.rationale: Duplicate UUIDs are strong indicator of wallet impersonation attack.

properties.description: Fee market parameters MUST come from trusted protocol calculations, not external input
properties.rationale: Malicious parameters could cause DoS via non-convergent series or extreme fee values.

properties.description: Numbers MUST be converted to standard integer type before validation operations
properties.formal_specification: FORALL n: Validate(n) => ConvertToInt(n) BEFORE validation
properties.rationale: Consistent type handling prevents precision loss or overflow in validation.

properties.description: Users MUST be able to distinguish between legitimate and impersonating wallets
properties.rationale: Users must make informed choices; visual similarity enables phishing attacks.

properties.description: Fork type MUST be correctly determined before applying fork-specific fields
properties.rationale: Incorrect fork detection causes header field mismatch and validation failure.

properties.description: Attackers may inject code before legitimate wallet extensions announce
properties.rationale: First-to-announce advantage enables impersonation of legitimate wallets.

properties.description: RDNS domain ownership CANNOT be verified by protocol; treat as hint only
properties.rationale: Protocol cannot verify RDNS claims; attackers can use arbitrary domains.

properties.description: Browser CSP MUST allow data: URIs for wallet icon rendering
properties.rationale: Restrictive CSP may block wallet icons, degrading UX and impersonation detection.

properties.description: ceil32 MUST be idempotent: applying twice produces same result as once
properties.rationale: Idempotence ensures gas calculations are stable under repeated application.

properties.description: Chain ID MUST be set from genesis configuration during initialization
properties.rationale: Chain ID is critical for transaction signing and replay protection.

properties.description: Raw bytes for cryptographic operations MUST come from validated sources
properties.rationale: Malformed bytes could cause cryptographic operation failures or corruption.

properties.description: Multiple providers with same RDNS but different UUIDs SHOULD be displayed for user choice
properties.formal_specification: SameRDNS(p1, p2) AND p1.uuid != p2.uuid => DisplayBoth(p1, p2)
properties.rationale: Multiple wallet instances may legitimately share RDNS; user should choose.
